name: CloudKit database
description: Stores records in the user's private iCloud database with CloudKit, mapping records to Sendable value types and reporting iCloud account problems clearly.

cost.note: Needs a paid Apple Developer Program membership for the iCloud container; CloudKit usage within Apple's free allowance has no extra charge

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Make each stored type conform to `CloudRecordConvertible` (a `recordType`, `init?(record:)` and `fill(_:)`). Use `CloudKitStore.privateDatabase()` (an `any CloudStore`) to `save`, `fetchAll` and `delete`, and call `accountProblem()` first to show why sync is unavailable (signed out, restricted). Use `PreviewCloudStore` in previews. For SwiftData models, prefer swiftdata-cloudkit-sync instead.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify cloudkit-database` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
